Food wise - breakfast is okay
Dinner and Lunch - Have not tried

Staying at this hotel truly left a lasting impression—its impeccable cleanliness and inviting ambiance set the stage for a perfect getaway. From the moment I stepped through the door, the reception area greeted me with polished surfaces, soft lighting, and a serene layout, exuding warmth and professionalism. Every corner felt meticulously maintained, showcasing a dedication to hygiene and guest well‑being.

In the guest rooms, everything felt brand new. Crisp linens adorned the queen bed, with plush pillows resting atop neatly arranged blankets. The floors, whether carpeted or tiled, appeared spotless—no dust or debris in sight. High‑touch areas like door handles, switches, and the bathroom fixtures were thoroughly cleaned, clearly part of the hotel's attention to detail. Even the minibar and work desk were well‑organized, making for a clutter-free environment that was both functional and calming.

The bathroom continued this trend of excellence. Bright white tiles and chrome fittings gleamed under ambient lighting. Towels were impeccably folded and placed just right. The shower had excellent water pressure, and the complimentary toiletries—shampoo, conditioner, and soap—displayed a thoughtful aesthetic on a clean tray, adding to the feeling of luxury.

One of the most delightful aspects was the tranquil ambiance. Soft, warm lighting throughout both rooms and common areas created a relaxing atmosphere. Muted, neutral color palettes enhanced a sense of comfort, allowing you to unwind naturally. Whether unwinding in a reading nook or settling into an armchair in the lounge, the environment felt like a sanctuary after a long day.

Housekeeping staff were both courteous and thorough. They cleaned quietly and efficiently, with minimal disturbance, always greeting in a friendly way
